# Custom Ink

> > Custom Ink is an online platform for designing and ordering custom apparel, promotional products, and branded merchandise with no minimum orders and expedited delivery options.

Custom Ink specializes in on-demand custom apparel and promotional products with a focus on group ordering, fundraising, and bulk customization. The platform features an intuitive design tool, competitive pricing, and expedited Super Rush Delivery service.

## Key Topics

- Custom apparel design
- T-shirt customization
- Promotional products
- Logo customization
- Group ordering
- No minimum orders
- Bulk customization
- Super Rush Delivery
- Design tool
- Fundraising
- Embroidery
- Satisfaction guarantee
- Product catalog
- Rush delivery
- Team uniforms

## Core Products

- [Custom T-shirts: Design & Make Your Own Custom Shirts Online](https://www.customink.com/products/t-shirts/4): Custom t-shirt design tool with free shipping and hundreds of styles available
- [Custom Apparel: Design Your Own Custom & Branded Clothing Online](https://www.customink.com/products/apparel/857): Custom apparel design platform for branded clothing and team uniforms
- [Custom Sweatshirts & Hoodies | Design Personalized & Embroidered Sweatshirts & Hoodies](https://www.customink.com/products/sweatshirts/13): Custom sweatshirt and hoodie design with 100+ styles and bulk discounts
- [Custom Hats: Design Branded Hats with Your Logo | Custom Hat Designer](https://www.customink.com/products/hats/1): Custom hat and baseball cap designer with logo embroidery options
- [Custom Outerwear & Jackets | Design Branded Logo Jackets](https://www.customink.com/products/jackets/14): Custom jacket and outerwear design with embroidery and bulk ordering
